# Archive catalogue update

I need your decision on whether to expand the next trial to Shelf C, and whether photographs should be included. Please give me that decision by 2026-11-03. Audio recordings will remain excluded in either case.

I finished entering the 48 packets from Shelf B in the new catalogue, using their original shelf order and retaining their packet names. The independent reader retrieved 46 packets on the first attempt. The other 2 needed label corrections: B-17 and B-32. No packets were lost and I changed no contents. After those corrections, the repeat check on 2026-10-13 retrieved all 48 packets in order.

I kept the original names beside the corrected labels and recorded each correction. That gives the next reader the information to repeat the check without depending on anyone's memory. The completed trial covered packet retrieval only; it did not test photographs or audio recordings.

The final cost was $1,248.75 against a $1,500 budget. Catalogue entry cost $900, and the independent retrieval checks cost $348.75. The remaining $251.25 stays in the archive budget. There is no continuing subscription or service commitment, and these trial costs do not estimate a wider rollout.

The review accepted both corrections and kept the original packet order. Expansion is postponed until the next review. I have not started work on Shelf C or included any photographs. The catalogue and the correction record are ready for that review.
